findings.observed_failure: A complete summary JSON object was followed by an extra closing brace. Pydantic parsing failed.
findings.probable_cause: Unconstrained generation produced malformed JSON. Retrying the unchanged request replayed the same persistent cache entry.
findings.resolution: One schema-error fallback adds a formatting repair instruction, creating a distinct cacheable request. The schema stays enforced and a second invalid answer remains an error.
findings.record_disposition: Historical capture retained for audit; never added to the vendored response bundle or relabeled as a valid answer.
findings.verification: Both extractor definitions passed malformed-response and bounded-retry regressions. Notebook 5 completed against real services after the repair.
